media_work.title: FRONTLINE
media_work.focus_or_theme: Plea bargaining system, innocent defendants pleading guilty, prosecutorial pressure, inadequate defense counsel, impact of poverty on justice outcomes.
media_work.summaryNotes: Highlights how the vast majority of cases are resolved through pleas, often pressuring innocent individuals.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Plea bargaining system, innocent defendants pleading guilty, prosecutorial pressure, inadequate defense counsel, impact of poverty on justice outcomes.
key_quotes_raw: Stewart describing the pressure to take the plea to care for her children; Kelly discussing the inadequate time/advice from court-appointed counsel; Discussion of the informant's unreliability coming out later.
systemic_issues_raw: The overwhelming pressure of the plea bargain system, particularly on poor defendants; inadequate resources and potential conflicts of interest for court-appointed attorneys; the devastating collateral consequences of a felony conviction (even via plea); the potential for unreliable informants to cause widespread injustice; racial disparities in drug enforcement.
policy_recommendations_raw: Implied need for reform in the plea bargaining process, better funding and oversight of indigent defense, scrutiny of informant use, addressing collateral consequences.

featured_individuals.exoneration_or_release_year: N/A (Plea stood, though cases against others were dismissed)
featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Felony drug distribution (pleaded guilty, maintained innocence)
contributing_factors_raw: Coercive plea bargaining, pressure to get out of jail for children, inadequate legal counsel, unreliable confidential informant, poverty.
featured_individuals.status_raw: Conviction stood due to plea, faced collateral consequences (loss of benefits).
organizations_involved_raw: ACLU (represented co-defendant Kelly in subsequent lawsuit).

contributing_factors_raw: Arrest based on unreliable confidential informant, racial bias alleged in drug sweep, pressure to plead guilty.
featured_individuals.status_raw: Charges dismissed; lead plaintiff in ACLU class-action lawsuit.
featured_individuals.**also_mentioned: ** Others arrested in the Hearne, Texas drug sweep (27 total, mostly African American).
